lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the gill region. A primary vertical column of four high-intensity spots is located directly dorsal to the pectoral fin insertion, followed posteriorly by a semi-regular grid of smaller spots.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance are visible intersecting with the horizontal rows of spots, forming the appearance of anchor nodes within a rectangular grid on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with highlights on the dorsal-facing edge and shadows on the ventral-facing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A thin, horizontal linear mark of high pixel intensity, consistent with a superficial scratch, is visible on the mid-flank between the second and third spot columns posterior to the gill slits.
other_distinctive_markers: Five distinct vertical gill slits are visible on the anterior portion of the shark, showing a clear dark-to-light intensity gradient across the branchial openings.
